name: Johanan
bio: Johanan son of Kareah, a Jewish military captain who had submitted to Gedaliah's governorship, warned Gedaliah of Ishmael's plot to assassinate him and offered to kill Ishmael first, but Gedaliah refused to believe it. After Ishmael carried out the murder and fled with captives, Johanan pursued him, freed the captives at Gibeon, and led the surviving remnant toward Egypt, seeking Jeremiah's guidance along the way — guidance the group ultimately ignored by fleeing to Egypt anyway (Jeremiah 40:7-43:7).
